item.description:
### Protection
- New "VPN & Tor Block" on Home: blocks VPN and Tor apps and their websites, and disconnects a VPN tunnel left running by a blocked app. Organisation-managed Macs follow the console's VPN & Tor setting.
### Managed Macs
- App usage, website visits and block counts now report to your organisation or family console, so its usage charts fill in for this Mac. - The macOS password prompt no longer counts as app usage.
